content.title: ‘Euphoria’ season 3 premieres tonight: How to watch with this streaming bundle deal
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.After nearly four years of anticipation, HBO’s “Euphoria” is finally back. Season 3 of Sam Levinson’s Emmy-winning drama premieres tonight, Sunday, April 12, with the eight-episode season airing weekly at 9 p.m. Eastern.Best streaming options for “Euphoria” season 3Besides streaming the show on HBO Max, you now have the option to bundle and save with Philo’s Bundle+ package. Bundle+ includes HBO Max Basic (ad supported) and discovery+ along with its own expansive library. This bundle tier lets “Euphoria” fans watch without paying for an add-on subscription. Includes access to HBO originals, Warner Bros. films, Max Originals, DC, and more. Live sports included on select plans.Get HBO Max Watch on HBO Max for as little as $10.99 per month to access HBO's full library of originals and more.Try HBO MaxSeason 3’s five-year time jumpSeason 3 makes the most dramatic narrative leap in the series’ history: A five-year time jump that moves the story beyond high school and into adulthood. Creator Sam Levinson confirmed that the decision was intentional, allowing the characters to deal with lasting consequences rather than repeating teen drama beats. Rue Bennett (Zendaya) is introduced in a far darker place—south of the U.S. border and indebted to Laurie, the drug dealer who nearly destroyed her in season 2.The returning cast—and who’s missingZendaya returns as Rue, continuing a performance that has already earned her two Primetime Emmy Awards, making her the youngest two-time winner in her category. Other returning leads include Hunter Schafer (Jules), Sydney Sweeney (Cassie), Jacob Elordi (Nate), Alexa Demie (Maddy) and Maude Apatow (Lexi). Notably absent is Barbie Ferreira, who exited the show following season 2, and Angus Cloud, whose death in 2023 left a profound impact. Because season 3 was filmed before Eric Dane’s death in February 2026, this marks his final on-screen appearance as Cal Jacobs.Expanded ensemble, new facesNew additions to the season include Natasha Lyonne, Danielle Deadwyler, Sharon Stone, Rosalía, Marshawn Lynch and Trisha Paytas, among others.
